referenceSources.description:
This grey, red, and white Seat Ibiza Cupra R carries the racing number 363 and features decals for clubgti.com, BARC, and the Classic Touring Car Racing Club. It is parked on a gravel driveway in front of a wooden gate and brick wall, emphasizing its track-ready stance and aerodynamic modifications.

Originally listed for £7,500 on Racecarsdirect.com, this 2002 model was equipped with a welded-in safety cage, fully adjustable Leda suspension, limited-slip differential, electric extinguisher system, carbon racing seat, new clutch, and a new turbo. It comes with two sets of wheels for dry and wet conditions and has a proven record of class wins in tarmac rallies, MSVR, and VW Challenge events.
